newsitem.title: USA: Dow sluggish and weak as bonds flag, Nasdaq steady.
newsitem.headline: Dow sluggish and weak as bonds flag, Nasdaq steady.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average was stuck at lower levels on Tuesday, hampered by weakness in the long bond following data which showed a surge in U.S. consumer confidence.

The Dow was off 34 points at 7312, not much above session lows of 7302, while the benchmark 30-year Treasury traded down 20/32 at a 7.04 percent yield. Bonds were spooked after the Conference Board said the index of U.S. consumer confidence hit a 28-year high of 127.1 in May, versus 118.5 in April.
But Nasdaq steadied itself, trading up 0.84 points to 1391, boosted by the technology stocks.
